items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: I know a good, this jockey friend of mine... Me and him used to talk about it, see, because he used to come to Doudrop quite often.

ctx.x: Is it possible, and someone mentioned this to me, it was, you raised your social status.

Well, yeah, I think in a sense, you know, because if this white lady wants you, well, you know, you just raise your social status. And the same way with a black woman, with a white man. You know, because the whites at that time, that was the ultimate. And you just raise your status. And although it was kept quiet, but now I say this much, the white men did it more than the black men. Much more. And all you got to do is go around and look at the people. Yeah. Touche. Show the truth. I know a good, this jockey…
He's not. He's not. He's not. Um. Can you find a wall? Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .
